publisher: Village of Tremont, IL (zoning map layer hosted by its consultant, keson_CMTengr)
notes: Village of Tremont zoning map layer (Zoning, 1153 polygons). Parcel-based: each polygon is a parcel carrying its zoning code, so it is a fallback, not a district layer; the village posts its zoning map only as PDF. Codes include R-1, R-2, R-3, B-1, B-2, I-1, OF, PA, N-1. Covers Tremont only.
